title: Lecture Notes on General Relativity
institution: MIT Physics 8.962 (Spring 1996); distributed via arXiv and the author's site
description: A lightly edited version of the notes handed out while teaching MIT's graduate course 8.962 in Spring 1996 (238 pages): 1 Special Relativity and Flat Spacetime; 2 Manifolds; 3 Curvature; 4 Gravitation; 5 More Geometry; 6 Weak Fields and Gravitational Radiation; 7 The Schwarzschild Solution and Black Holes; 8 Cosmology. Later expanded into the textbook Spacetime and Geometry.
rightsNotes: arXiv record gr-qc/9712019 (v1, submitted 3 December 1997, 'Comments: 238 pages, numerous figures'): the rights link points to arXiv's assumed licence for 1991–2003 submissions, under which arXiv holds a perpetual non-exclusive licence to distribute the article; no reuse licence is granted to readers.

The author's page (preposterousuniverse.com/grnotes/) shows 'Copyright © 2026 Sean Carroll' and states 'The notes as they are will always be here for free'; it names no licence. Corniversity therefore treats the notes as reference-only: cite and link, do not copy or ingest.

Convention: the notes and the textbook that grew from them use signature (−,+,+,+); this was not re-verified inside the PDF on 2026-10-30 and is stated here from the author's textbook practice, so the PHY-240 units announce the signature themselves rather than relying on this note.
